resources.string: When the match\'s channel goes to its adverts (before kick-off, at half time, after the game: its logo goes), Homefield\'s own break takes over, with the channel in a small window: what\'s on your TV to carry on, new episodes, your list and reminders, the other games, the headlines, a trailer, fun facts, a quiz, today\'s prayer times from Darus Salam Mosque and the weather. Back to the channel when the adverts end.

The scoreboard, the mark over the channel\'s logo and the scoreboard over other apps move a pixel or two every minute, and dim a little after five minutes without a change, so they never burn into the screen.
